summary: DarkIris Inc., a Cayman-incorporated Hong Kong-based prepackaged software foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the filing of its Fifth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association with the Cayman Registrar on October 26, 2026. Shareholders approved the amendments at an extraordinary general meeting on October 6, 2026, and the board ratified them October 8, 2026. The charter restates authorized capital of USD500,000,000 across Class A and Class B ordinary shares at USD0.08 par. No transaction, price, or advisor is involved; this is a routine governance/meeting matter, not a special situation.
